notes.title: Workaround To Make Paper Cut Mansion Run On Your Steam Deck!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915747/feb247fb80db5d7050df43731c5843f24887e715.jpg[/img]

Heya Friends,

As you can see on the product page, [b]Paper Cut Mansion[/b] was rated "unsupported" for the Steam Deck. Installing the game on a Deck, starting it and pressing any gamepad button will make the game freeze.

Unfortunately, this is not just an issue in [b]Paper Cut Mansion[/b], it's a problem that a hell a lot of Unity games are facing at the moment - and that is really damn frustrating! On the Deck, the games automatically launch under Proton 7.0.4, and that causes the freeze.

There is a simple workaround that allows you to change the Proton version to 6.3-8, so [b]Paper Cut Mansion[/b] will work fine on the Steam deck. Just follow these instructions from [url=https://www.windowscentral.com/gaming/pc-gaming/how-to-change-proton-version-on-steam-deck]Windows Central[/url]:

[olist][*] Select your chosen game from the Steam Deck library carousel.
[*] Navigate to the settings cogwheel on the right side of the game page and select it.
[*] On the pop-up game settings menu, navigate to and select Properties.
[*] In this game properties screen, choose Compatibility from the left-side menu.
[*] Check the box titled 'Force the use of a specific Steam Play compatibility tool.'
[*] From the new drop-down box underneath, select Proton version 6.3-8.
[*] Return to your game and check for updates if it doesn't happen automatically.[/olist]
Fingers crossed that the problem will be fixed soon. We will of course keep you updated and submit the game for review again asap!

Spooky greetings out of the Mansion!
Gabriele & The Paper Cut Mansion Team

notes.title: Paper Cut Mansion Supports Razer Chroma, Sweepstakes Live! 🐍
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915747/e9179838501ec668f4d323e6662d4185ebf84ec8.jpg[/img]

Halloween is close, friends!

And Halloween is not only the time of spooky Steam Scream Fest, it's also the time of dim candlelight and the glowing-grinning grimaces of Jack O'Lantern! And - as the release is only two days away - it's also the right time of creepy Chroma RGB illumination in [b]Paper Cut Mansion[/b]!

At RazerCon 2022 on October 15 we officially announced the [b]Paper Cut Mansion[/b] release date plus Razer Chroma support. So, in the case you own Razer Chroma peripherals (or you win them - more about that later), you will notice very quickly after launching the game that the RGB Illumination responds to it. "Neat, but why should I need that" you think? Fair enough! But let me explain why in our opinion, a spooky RGB illumination is a perfect fit for our spooky papercraft roguelite.

[previewyoutube=nCNQp9_6Bfk;full][/previewyoutube]
The core of [b]Paper Cut Mansion[/b] is - of course - the namesake mansion. There you puzzle, fight and investigate the various floors. Each floor has a different theme and contains portals that lead you to alternate versions of the same location. And each of the three dimensions has a base color: The NeonCortex Dimension is purple, the Reptilian Complex is red and the Limbic System Dimension is blue.

And so, of course, it's a simple one, that the color mood of the game can be perfectly extended beyond the monitor by illuminating your Chroma peripherals: mouse, mouse pad, headset and keyboard. And in case you use LED strips or compatible ambient lights, you can immerse the whole room in the threatening red of the Reptilian Complex Dimension or the icy blue of the Limbic System Dimension. This has a pretty cool (LOL) effect!

Atmospheric illumination? Check! Plus we experimented with more different Chroma effects that are triggered by certain actions in the game. But I don't want to tell you too much about it here. Finally, it won't be long until Paper Cut Mansion will be available, then you can see the Chroma support for yourself.

And - to celebrate the Paper Cut Mansion release and the Chroma support - we've started a sweepstakes that you can participate in AS OF NOW! We've teamed up with Razer to offer you these awesome prizes:

[list][*] 1x Razer Cynosa V2 Gaming Keyboard

[*] 1x Razer Firefly V2 Gaming Mouse Pad

How to take part? Click [url=https://gleam.io/pb9WW/win-razer-chroma-equipment-paper-cut-mansion][b]HERE[/b][/url] or on the artwork above to enter our sweepstakes page on Gleam and follow the instructions there!

notes.title: Behind The Cardboard #02: From Floor To Floor To Floor In The Paper Cut Mansion!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915747/2d2f4f73609b934faa3b839b630f8e69d360f139.jpg[/img]

Happy Friday, friends!

Just a few more sleeps, then it's finally time: After about five years of development, [b]Paper Cut Mansion[/b] will release on October 27. WOOHOO! Unbelievable, but true. And for us as a small team consisting of 3 developers, this is a really big success, and a matter of the heart. I can tell you that!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915747/c638e22c6738504a6d2ee7b816b88160ec1acacd.jpg[/img]
[i]The NeoCortex dimension, filled with challenges, logic puzzles and collectibles[/i]

But what kind of a game is [b]Paper Cut Mansion[/b]? And how does it work? I know it of course, but let me take a quick look on our lovely Steam page real quick. So, it's a "papercraft roguelite". You get in the paper shoes of police detective Toby Caputo and you players explore the namesake mysterious mansion floor by floor.

As Toby you enter the mansion for the very first time. It consists of several floors that you must explore, investigate, survive, and make your way through - deeper and deeper, always towards the mystery. And as befits a roguelite, you won't make it on the first try. Or on the second. Or even on the third. But that's not our fault, because that's how roguelites work.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915747/fede89a118ace172bb617211eecae74fbeb5b137.jpg[/img]
[i]The Reptilian Complex dimension is overrun with monsters - so raise your weapons![/i]

And run by run you will define your very own playstyle as you unlock new abilities and discover new equipment that will give you a better chance to overcome the challenges each (procedurally generated) run throws at you. You will find a bunch of new items (various weapons, skills and armors) that offer further customisation, allowing for truly unique set ups. Do you want to get in close with a Katana or take shots from afar as a skilled marksman? Then do it!

Speaking of the floors: The mansion itself has a dimension-hopping twist. Each floor has a different theme and contains portals that lead you to alternate versions of the same location. Each dimension switches up the aesthetics, and with it the gameplay. Your run always start in the NeoCortex dimension, which plays out like an escape room, filled with challenges, logic puzzles and a lot of collectibles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915747/92e896165541c3dfbaf3660815ead6c0bd7d4b29.jpg[/img]
[i]The Limbic System dimension is a merciless cold place full of hidden items and secrets[/i]

From there, you will receive quests that take you into the Reptilian Complex and the Limbic System Dimensions. In the Reptilian Complex, the mansion takes on a fiery silent-hilly appearance as it is overrun with monsters (Raise your weapons!). The Limbic system sees an icy chill overtake the mansion. You’ll need to move quickly and stay near heat sources as the merciless cold damages Toby on his search for hidden items and secrets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915747/bd96958494c9c344f29f1e1bb6b6d26a9655e67a.jpg[/img]
[i]Before every run you can equip Toby with the gear and weapons you find in earlier runs[/i]

Btw. there are decisions to make throughout your run that subtly affecting the final outcome - with 27 different possible endings wrapping up the mystery of [b]Paper Cut Mansion[/b].

Until next week, friends - stay safe & stay tuned!
Gabriele & The Paper Cut Mansion Team

notes.title: Behind The Cardboard #01: The Paper Cut Mansion Arises: From Drawing to 3D!" ✏️
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915747/66e4c8f9b49bc7f5330dead03af77d15923f6076.jpg[/img]

Heya friends!

It's me again, Gabriele! As the release of [b]Paper Cut Mansion[/b] is getting closer each and every day ([b]October 27!!![/b] ːsteamhappyː), I want to see you prepared for all the spooky dangers, that await you on the various floors of our cardboard mansion.

That's why I will tell you more about our papercraft roguelite in the upcoming days till the release with our little making-of update series "Behind The Cardboard" - starting today with the first chapter "The Mansion Arises: From Drawing to 3D!". Enjoy!

[previewyoutube=WUHRSTU8MHs;full][/previewyoutube]
So, this is a sneak peak behind the scenes, behind the curtain, behind the cardboard. In this process I show you how our paper craft horror is made and how we craft our hand drawn world. I literally grab a piece of paper, draw some weird shapes on it (that only I understand apparently) with just standard pencils, no need of fancy expensive posh pencils, just the ones that a kid would use.

Once I am done with the drawing I scan the sheet of paper and import it in PhotoShop for the color touch. Then I "fold" it using the 3D software Blender exactly like as I would fold a paper cutout (in fact you could take this very texture from the video and make your own real paper crafts). The whole thing then is imported into Unity for some animations and boom - it takes life!

That's it for today, friends! Be sure to wishlist and follow [b]Paper Cut Mansion[/b] to get informed about all the upcoming making-of updates we are going to publish till release!

Until then, friends - stay safe & stay tuned!
Gabriele & The Paper Cut Mansion Team

notes.title: Unfold the Mystery Behind the Handcrafted Cardboard World of Paper Cut Mansion!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915747/587eb7db30015ee41c9dc845b4eef22e425d6b93.jpg[/img]

Greetings friends!

And welcome to the Steam page of [b]Paper Cut Mansion[/b]! My name is Gabriele, I am the Game Director of [b]Paper Cut Mansion[/b], and it is a great honor to introduce you all to the world of our little horror roguelite, set in a handcrafted world made of cardboard.

So, what is [b]Paper Cut Mansion[/b] in a nutshell? As said, it is a horror roguelite game that offers exploration, detective work, dimension-hopping, combat, puzzles and more. You will explore the titular mansion floor by floor, solve puzzles, battle enemies and complete quests as you unlock new abilities to aid you on each run and seek to solve the mystery behind the mansion.

You play as Toby, a police detective who arrives on a road leading to the eponymous old mansion. You will put those detective skills to the test as you seek to unravel the story behind this bizarre place, with each run giving you the opportunity to collect another piece of evidence to be tacked on the Evidence Board.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gnQKSeav_Yk
Run by run the game will offer you the opportunity of defining your playstyle as you unlock new abilities and discover new equipment that will give you a better chance of overcoming the challenges each procedurally generated run throws at you. Intrigue is further added through a dimension-hopping mechanic that lets you leap between alternate versions of the same location that switch up the aesthetics and gameplay.

[b]Paper Cut Mansion[/b]'s aesthetics are rendered using traditional and digital means. Each texture is hand-drawn on paper, then scanned into a computer, to be modeled into 3D paper crafts. It was an incredible amount of work, but it is totally worth it! We are a small team and have been working on Paper Cut Mansion for almost 5 years now.

Slowly but surely, however, we are turning into the home straight, and that feels damn good! We look forward to sharing more info and content out of [b]Paper Cut Mansion[/b] with you soon!

Until then, friends - stay safe!
Gabriele & The Paper Cut Mansion Team
